Card Q&A.a: No. There are no security cards to trash, but this doesn't allow you to win the game.
Card Q&A.q: If my opponent has a level 7 Digimon in play and I use this card when my opponent's security stack is empty, do I win the game?

Effect: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has a level 7 Digimon in play, trash the top card of their security stack.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to its owner's hand.
